status: Discussion guide supplied by Sandra Keedy
intro:
The Villages We Choose invites readers to consider the people who shape us, the choices that define us, and the lives those choices ultimately create.

Whether you're gathering with longtime friends or meeting fellow readers for the first time, these questions are designed to inspire thoughtful conversations about Cynthia's story and perhaps your own.

questions.title: The life we inherit
questions.text: How did the instability, losses, and expectations of Cynthia's childhood influence the woman she became? At what point did she begin making choices that reflected the life she wanted rather than the life she had inherited?

questions.title: The choices that define us
questions.text: Which of Cynthia's decisions do you believe had the greatest influence on her life? Was its importance apparent when she made it, or did its significance become clear only in hindsight?

questions.title: Love and self-discovery
questions.text: What did Cynthia's relationships with Frank, Charlie, and Elliott reveal about her evolving understanding of love, partnership, and herself? How did her expectations change?

questions.title: The courage to begin again
questions.text: Several times, Cynthia faced decisions that required her to risk what she knew for a future she could not predict. Which decision demanded the greatest courage? Would you have made the same choice?

questions.title: The price of ambition
questions.text: What did Cynthia's professional success give her, and what did it cost her? Did your understanding of her ambition change as the novel progressed?

questions.title: Understanding and forgiveness
questions.text: How did Cynthia's relationships with her parents influence her choices as an adult? Is understanding someone's actions the same as forgiving them?

questions.title: The villages we create
questions.text: The novel explores the idea that our lives are shaped by emotional villages rather than physical places alone. Which relationships and experiences were most influential in creating Cynthia's villages? Which did she inherit, and which did she choose?

questions.title: The life we choose
questions.text: By the novel's conclusion, how has your understanding of Cynthia's choices changed? Looking at your own life, what are the villages you inherited, the villages you left, and the villages you chose?
